channel.title: Pysano Updates
channel.description: Stable and beta updates for Pysano.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.5
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 5
- Added custom voice actions for selected text. Each action can have a short spoken command, up to ten optional aliases, a Gemini editing instruction, and its own enabled state. - Added strict command boundaries: an action runs only when text was selected before recording and the complete recognized utterance matches a command of at most eight words. Commands are never searched for inside longer dictation, and phrase replacements remain a separate feature. - Added an optional, recommended `LOCAL → GEMINI` route. A local Whisper or Parakeet model recognizes the short command on the Mac, then only the selected text and editing instruction are sent to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. The recording itself stays local. - Added three result modes for selected-text actions: review a floating preview, replace the selection immediately, or copy the edited text to the clipboard. Preview is the recommended default and offers Replace, Copy, and Cancel. - The preview is positioned below the selected text when an app exposes Accessibility bounds, with a pointer-based fallback for browsers and editors that do not. Replacement still revalidates the original app, field, selection, and contents before pasting. - Hardened Gemini transformation prompts by encoding selected text as untrusted JSON data, while keeping user-authored action instructions separate. - Added migration-safe settings and complete Ukrainian, English, French, and Italian localization for custom actions, routing, previews, validation, and errors.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.4
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 4
- Added optional live draft text for installed local Whisper and Parakeet models. It refreshes from the latest 15 seconds while recording, stays entirely on the Mac, and never replaces the final full-recording pass. - Added automatic phrase replacements for reusable names, email addresses, links, and short snippets. Rules are stored locally, respect word boundaries, and run once without cascading into other rules. - Added exact voice commands for editing selected text: shorten, fix and polish, turn into a list, translate to English, and translate to Ukrainian. - Selected text is sent to Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite only when voice actions are enabled, text was selected before recording, and one exact command is recognized. Ordinary local dictation never uploads the selection. - Added focus and selection revalidation before insertion so text changed during processing is left untouched. - Added complete Ukrainian, English, French, and Italian localization for the new settings, commands, privacy explanations, and errors.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.3
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 3
- Fixed the inert **Names and custom terms** section while a local Auto-mode route is active. The vocabulary now remains editable and clearly shows whether it is active for Gemini or saved for a later Gemini route. - Added quick term entry, newline-list clipboard import, case-insensitive duplicate cleanup, focused-list guidance, and safe bulk-import limits. - Added optional speech protection to prevent silent or noisy recordings from inserting hallucinated text. It is enabled by default with a recommended 0.25-second minimum and can be adjusted from 0.10 to 1.00 seconds. - Speech detection runs locally with an adaptive noise floor. Short clicks and steady background noise are rejected; the recording remains available for Retry after changing the threshold. - Gemini Live still streams audio during recording, but rejected sessions are canceled before finalization and insert no text. - Added complete Ukrainian, English, French, and Italian localization for the new controls and feedback.

# Pysano 0.7.1
- The **Repair Key Access** action now rebuilds the legacy Keychain item's ACL once for Pysano's stable code signature, preventing an unlock prompt on every launch. - The API key remains in Keychain; there are no automatic system prompts and the key is never saved to project files. - Added four feedback sound sets: Liquid, Soft Chime, Pulse, and macOS System. - Liquid is the new default short cue. Every option can be previewed in Settings without starting a recording, and sound feedback can still be disabled completely.

# Pysano 0.7.0
- Made the dictation indicator smaller and moved its default position to the top so it does not cover the input field. - Added top, bottom, left, and right indicator placement options. - The completion message can be hidden or displayed for 0.5, 1, 2, or 4 seconds; the default is 1 second. - Added native macOS sounds at recording start and completion, with a separate sound toggle.

# Pysano 0.6.2
- Added a focused-node fallback for ChatGPT, Codex, and other Chromium/Electron/WebKit editors that expose `AXGroup` or `AXWebArea` instead of a standard text AX role. - Before insertion, Pysano revalidates the original app, window, and Accessibility node; password and secure containers remain blocked. - A missing Accessibility permission is no longer masked by an unknown text-field message. - After a failed attempt, the menu offers sanitized focus diagnostics that exclude field text, selection, keystrokes, and clipboard contents.
